_about: Single source of truth for theme tokens. HTML (themes.css) and PPTX (scripts/deckkit.py) both read from here. `accent` is a BRAND SLOT: replace it with the brand colour of the deck owner; everything else stays. Run scripts/gen_theme_css.py after editing.

ledger.label: Ledger — dense & analytical
ledger.use_for: data-heavy decks, many tables and charts, formal tone
ledger.motif: dark verdict bar; black pill section tag; numbers 01/02 in accent_2; divider = flat accent wave with accent_2 outline; cover = deep navy radial glow

horizon.label: Horizon — calm & corporate
horizon.use_for: long structured decks with repeating page pairs; calm, formal
horizon.motif: corner tab flush to the top-right edge; small accent_2 chips as card headers; dark navy panels; sky-gradient covers

bloom.label: Bloom — warm & friendly
bloom.use_for: light, friendly decks where images or product visuals lead
bloom.motif: soft blurred colour blobs bleeding from corners; light (400) titles with one phrase coloured accent; result panel in accent_3; no hard black

signal.label: Signal — bold & energetic
signal.use_for: confident decks with many 'growth' numbers and before/after comparisons
signal.motif: accent flare from the top-right corner over white; breadcrumb pill pair (accent + black); white cards with hairline; round black → button; strikethrough old vs new

aurora.label: Aurora — soft & modern
aurora.use_for: modern, soft-tech decks with matrices and segment tabs
aurora.motif: full-width gradient header band (accent→accent_2→accent_3) with the section name; frosted white cards; covers = frosted glass panel over pastel gradient with dot grid

ember.label: Ember — compact & direct
ember.motif: thin header band = accent fading into grey; large light titles; filled chips for risks; dark covers with vertical accent→black stripes
